_readme: SEED DRAFT (2026-09-01) for the experimental Slider Build Control. Claude-authored first pass at Brian's request; Brian revises and owns the final wording.
Not a wildcard pack: files at the wildcards/ root are ignored by the pack scanner. Loaded once at ComfyUI start by bkwildcards/sliders.py; restart after editing.
Sliders are 0-10. Tiers: 0-1 = 'lowest', 2-3 = 'low', 4-6 = 'middle', 7-8 = 'high', 9-10 = 'highest'. EVERY tier emits its phrase (owner's call 2026-09-01: no silent averages, intentional control).

The register follows Gender: Female -> feminine, Male -> masculine, Fluid and — off — -> androgynous, — random — -> the rolled gender. Mode — random — on the Body Sliders selector rolls the five values from the seed.
Each phrase is a noun phrase fragment. The code joins them corpus-style: '<first> with <a>, <b>, <c>' (a plain comma list, because fragments may themselves contain 'and').
Emission order: mass -> tone -> silhouette -> bust -> waist -> hips. 'neutral' is only a safety fallback if a bank phrase is missing.

Silhouette is derived in code from the bust/waist/hips values (thresholds are tuning knobs in bkwildcards/sliders.py); only the labels live here. 'bust' means chest for the masculine and androgynous registers.

'presets' maps each Build preset SECTION (as the dropdown shows it) to a five-value slider vector. Under mode 'preset' the preset line emits and the sliders snap to this vector (display only); the values persist when you switch to 'on', so a preset works as a starting point. Seed values are Claude's first guess — owner edits.

hips.high: wide, curvy hips and thick thighs
hips.highest: very wide hips, a large rear and heavy thighs

tone.lowest: a soft, untoned body with no muscle definition
tone.low: a softly toned body with little muscle definition
tone.high: a toned, athletic, visibly muscular physique
tone.highest: a chiseled, hard-muscled, athletic physique with defined abs and cut arms

bust.high: a broad chest and wide shoulders
bust.highest: a huge barrel chest and heavy shoulders

waist.lowest: a tightly tapered, very narrow waist
waist.high: a thick waist and a soft midsection

hips.highest: very wide hips and heavy thighs

tone.lowest: a soft, untoned body with no muscle definition
tone.highest: a chiseled, heavily muscular bodybuilder's physique with defined abs and cut, veiny arms

bust.middle: a flat, lean chest, neither masculine nor feminine
bust.highest: a broad, deep, swimmer's chest with no bust

hips.middle: straight, squared hips on a straight torso
hips.high: broad, squared hips and sturdy thighs on a straight torso
hips.highest: wide, solid, squared hips and thick thighs on a straight torso

tone.lowest: a soft, untoned body with no muscle definition
tone.low: a softly toned body with little muscle definition
tone.high: a toned, athletic, visibly muscular physique
tone.highest: a chiseled, hard-muscled physique with defined abs and cut arms

silhouette.hourglass: a narrow-waisted, evenly proportioned androgynous figure
silhouette.pear: a bottom-heavy androgynous figure with squared hips
